edges.reason: transfer() forwards its arguments and _msgSender() into the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom() forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer before adjusting allowance.
_transfer finishes its checks and invokes _tokenTransfer to apply balances.
_tokenTransfer delegates the accounting to _transferStandard.
_transfer performs a router swap before the transfer accounting is completed, exposing a reentrancy window.
_transfer sends contract ETH to the fee wallet before finishing the transfer, exposing a reentrancy window.
sendETHToFee executes an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call with amountOutMin = 0.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with value = address(this).balance.
openTrading calls the factory to create the trading pair.
openTrading approves the router on the pair token for the maximum amount.
manualswap triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
manualsend triggers sendETHToFee which performs an external ETH transfer.
manualswap authorization depends on msg.sender being equal to _feeAddrWallet.
manualsend authorization depends on msg.sender being equal to _feeAddrWallet.
_transfer enforces cooldown using block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
nonosquare writes the bots blacklist mapping under onlyOwner.
delBot writes the bots blacklist mapping under onlyOwner.
changeMaxTxAmount computes _maxTxAmount via multiplication and division on a user-supplied percentage.
changeMaxWalletSize computes _maxWalletSize via multiplication and division on a user-supplied percentage.
removeLimits resets _maxTxAmount to the total supply.
removeLimits resets _maxWalletSize to the total supply.
approve() delegates argument handling to _approve.
transferFrom() decrements the allowance through _approve.
_approve writes the computed value into _allowances.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard invokes _takeTeam for the team allocation.
_transferStandard invokes _reflectFee for the fee allocation.
_takeTeam credits the computed reflected team amount to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, mutating the global rate.
_reflectFee accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues to derive token fee components.
_getValues calls _getRValues to derive reflected components.
_getValues reads the current reflection rate.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned by _getRate.
balanceOf converts the stored reflected balance through tokenFromReflection.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve before swapping.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading assigns the router address to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading sets the initial _maxTxAmount.
openTrading sets the initial _maxWalletSize.
The lockTheSwap modifier toggles inSwap around the router swap.
The constructor mints the entire reflected supply to the deployer.
The constructor hardcodes the fee wallet address.
The constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallet as fee-exempt.
_transfer writes the tax fee percentage into _feeAddr1.
_transfer writes the team fee percentage into _feeAddr2.
_transfer reads and writes cooldown entries using block.timestamp.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to bypass limits and fees.
_transfer validates the amount against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer validates recipient balance against _maxWalletSize.
_transfer gates the automatic swap on swapEnabled.
_getValues feeds the current _feeAddr1 tax percentage into the fee math.
_getValues feeds the current _feeAddr2 team percentage into the fee math.
The external router swap triggers token transfers that can call back into _transfer while state is mid-update.
The external ETH transfer to the fee wallet can invoke recipient code that re-enters transfer logic.
receive() accepts unsolicited ETH that is later swept by manualswap/swapTokensForEth, providing an external entry point into swap flow.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter only serves transfer(); merge into the core transfer function.
amount parameter only serves transfer(); merge into the core transfer function.
sender parameter only serves transferFrom(); merge into the core transferFrom function.
recipient parameter only serves transferFrom(); merge into the core transferFrom function.
amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom allowance subtraction; merge into transferFrom.
spender parameter only serves approve(); merge into the core approve function.
amount parameter only serves approve(); merge into the core approve function.
from address is central to _transfer's blacklist, limit and fee logic.
to address is central to _transfer's blacklist, cooldown and limit logic.
amount drives _transfer's limit and cooldown checks.
contractTokenBalance is immediately passed to swapTokensForEth as the swap input.
contractETHBalance is immediately passed to sendETHToFee as the transfer amount.
tokenAmount is the direct input of the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
path array is constructed only to be supplied to the external router swap call.
amount parameter is the direct input of the external ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
bots_ array is iterated only by nonosquare to write the bots mapping.
notbot is used only by delBot to clear the bots mapping entry.
sender is forwarded straight through _tokenTransfer into the accounting routine.
recipient is forwarded straight through _tokenTransfer into the accounting routine.
amount is forwarded straight through _tokenTransfer into the accounting routine.
sender is debited directly in _transferStandard's reflected balance update.
recipient is credited directly in _transferStandard's reflected balance update.
tAmount is decomposed and applied entirely inside _transferStandard.
tTeam is converted and credited by _takeTeam only.
rFee is subtracted from _rTotal inside _reflectFee.
tFee is accumulated into _tFeeTotal inside _reflectFee.
rAmount is the sole input converted by tokenFromReflection.
percentage is used only to compute _maxTxAmount in changeMaxTxAmount.
percentage is used only to compute _maxWalletSize in changeMaxWalletSize.
onoff is written directly into cooldownEnabled by setCooldownEnabled.
account is only used to look up the reflected balance in balanceOf.
owner is only used as the allowance mapping key in allowance().
spender is only used as the allowance mapping key in allowance().
tAmount is the sole transfer amount decomposed by _getValues.
tAmount is the sole amount from which _getTValues derives fee components.
